title: Jack Rabbit Rio Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: As refreshing as it is moreish, Jack Rabbit’s bestselling Rio is a one-way ticket to tropical climes thanks to smooth coconut, tangy pineapple, fresh mango and tart papaya. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
